purpose: Test one strictly-prior opponent-adjusted Elo feature on top of frozen Ability v1 without market, M3, PCI/RPCI, or current-race scenario inputs.

universe.definition: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher

elo.expected_score: mean pairwise probability of finishing ahead of each opponent
elo.actual_score: normalized proportion of opponents beaten; tied finish=0.5

formula.race_projection: same common-logit shift as v1 so projected top3 probabilities sum to exactly 3.0

selection_protocol.K: selected by 5-fold GroupKFold by race on 2024 only; search range expanded because the initial optimum was at the boundary
selection_protocol.beta: fit on all 2024 only after K was frozen

m3_disagreement_near_reproduction.note: M3 ranks reconstructed from the current finish600 model using strictly-prior all-class history. Stored r32 pooled v1 mismatch counts are reproduced within at most 3 runners per bucket, but not byte-identically; do not use these counts as a probability correction.

interpretation.primary: Elo adds small but consistent OOS information to Ability v1: pooled AUC rises and LogLoss/Brier fall, with race-cluster 95% intervals excluding zero in the favorable direction.
interpretation.calibration: ECE is lower pooled, but its bootstrap CI crosses zero; no statistically resolved calibration-improvement claim.
interpretation.rank1: Rank1 top3 rate rises about 1.4 percentage points, but its CI crosses zero; evidence for v2 comes from full-distribution metrics rather than rank1 alone.
interpretation.m3: Ability and M3 remain separate layers; do not average their probabilities directly.

decision.next: Freeze this Elo specification and prospectively validate on genuinely unseen future races before production promotion.

caveats: K and beta use 2024 only, but the idea to add Elo was motivated after prior inspection of 2025/2026 behavior. Thus 2025/2026 are parameter-OOS, not a pristine idea-selection holdout.
The current 2026 source snapshot yields tiny differences from the stored r32 Ability v1 artifact. Comparisons here use the same current 700-race reconstruction for v1 and v2.
M3 cross-diagnostic is near-reproduced rather than exact and is diagnostic only.
